{{Quote|And they're off! Mon Gazza Maze qualifier race number one has begun!|The droid commentator|<ref name="CC" />}}
A [[Color/Legends|blue]] '''protocol droid''' worked as a [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] commentator around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] operated out of the circuits on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], and commentated on the [[Mon Gazza Maze/Legends|Mon Gazza Maze]] event on its qualifier races. The droid was known to get excited as races drew to a close, and reminded pedestrians to not walk onto the track during a race. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|droid]] had a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] [[Cybernetics/Legends|attachment]] augmented on his cranial unit.<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The droid was created by [[Henry Gilroy]] and appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novella]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Crash Course]]'', where it was illustrated by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach]] and colored by [[Ronda Pattison]]. Despite having lines throughout the comic, the droid only appeared in a single panel.<ref name="CC" />
